title: Chapter 718
paragraphs: Chapter 718
Episode 180. Their own fight (8)
The battlefield of Jin and Defus outside Ricarten.
The wilderness was breaking.
Like a giant storm, the lightning energy spreading from the Thunder Lightning Sword Sigmund was tearing the whole sky and ground.
Quite some time had passed since the two teleported from Ricarten Castle.
Despite the intense battle that distorted the entire landscape of the wilderness during that time, there was no significant injury to either of them.
They were unable to strike each other decisively.
Jin was the one wasting more energy.
While Defus was easily hitting and running through flight, Jin had to spread the lightning energy to the extent of controlling the entire battlefield in order to press him.
However, even though Jin was 'wasting' energy, it was not insufficient.
Defus, on the contrary, was marveling while pushing out the lightning energy that was getting deeper as time went on.
[Such power without receiving a grant like me……. I understand why you raised a banner against the mother. You wouldn't have felt the need.]
Defus dodged the lightning and spoke.
[However, not everyone can do like you.]
Jin did not answer and watched as the lightning that tore through the air disappeared somewhere before it struck the ground.
'This isn't the first time. My attacks that the 4th generation has been avoiding or blocking have been disappearing.'
At first, Jin didn't notice. The fight was so fierce that there was no time to check the afterimage of the missed sword.
However, the offense and defense of the two were now losing balance. The tight line was slightly pulled towards Jin.
There was only one reason.
Even if Defus received part of Rosa's power, he couldn't become stronger than Jin.
Even if it was intact, it would be the same, but it was in a state where the gap was widening faster because it suffered irreparable damage from the eternalization and used teleportation excessively.
'Where do my disappearing attacks go like that? Are they being converted to the 4th generation in some way, or......’
[It looks like you're worried about the ones left in Ricarten Castle. You keep losing focus while you just started to corner me.]
Zzzzzzz-!
Defus spoke as he swung down Bolgar. Jin shot a lightning bolt by lifting Sigmund, and he could see the same lightning bolt that missed disappearing.
"Stay focused. Taking care of the attack you dodged doesn't seem to be an act for fighting with me."
Suddenly, Jin withdrew all the lightning energy that filled the battlefield.
Defus slowly descended and shrugged his shoulders.
[You have a good eye. I didn't think you'd realize it so soon.]
"If I was worried about my companions, I would have tried to return to Ricarten Castle by any means. It's not like I would have had such a serious fight with you here."
Jin changes his sword.
"I honestly don't know why you're post-processing missed attacks. But now it doesn't matter. The exploration is over, from now on, you won't have the leisure to do such things..."
A pure white aura was wrapped around Bradamante.
The quietly shining aura was giving off a completely opposite atmosphere to the violently trampling lightning energy that had been all over the wilderness.
[You will use a lower level power, leaving behind lightning and spirit energy, are you okay with that?]
Jin changed his sword to minimize missed attacks.
The nature of the lightning energy was too violent, resulting in many inevitably leaked attacks.
Also, choosing aura instead of spirit energy was to save strength.
'He is sure he can't beat me. He's fighting with defeat already in mind.'
Jin had been getting that feeling from Defus continuously.
In fact, every single one of Defus' responses since the operation started was all ploys to buy time.
Separating Jin from his companions, spreading illusion magic towards Zipfel, deploying the most troops towards Kinzello.
It was the same now. Defus was protracting the fight by unnecessarily post-processing missed attacks.
Jin concluded that all these actions were to avoid Rosa's participation.
Another evidence was Orgal and Sirius.
It's been a while since Jin was separated from the group, but there's still no news of our teleportation ability users.

'Except for the abomination, there is no one in the Sword Garden's camp who can handle Orgal and Kinzello. However, the fact that teleportation ability users can't find me means that Orgal is tied somewhere.'
If Orgal had been with the allies in Ricarten Castle, they would have already sorted out the situation and started looking for Jin.
Especially with Orgal's abilities, he should have found Jin several times already.
And the only existence that could tie down such an Orgal was, in the Sword Garden, just one.
Abomination Rosa.
Orgal is currently unable to join the battlefield because he is preventing her participation.
That was the reason why Jin had to save his spirit energy. After dealing with Defus, he needed to support Orgal.

"Are you okay? Even though everything you've done has been that way... that's not something you, brother Defus, should say. You were a person who struggled only with the sword. Later, you expressed your willingness to participate in the demonic sword regression for the family, but still, you revered the sword the most. Because we're swordsmen."
"So show the essence of the Swordsman."
The moment Jin continued his speech, Difus felt a sensation of his vision suddenly becoming pure white.
What obstructed his view was the blade of Bradamante.
He was late in his response due to being accustomed to the speed of Thunder Energy.
Jin was unfolding Runcandel's Final Technique with a speed surpassing that of Thunder Energy.
Runcandel's 6th Final Technique: Lightning.
The Final Technique that Jin used on his first assassination mission with Difus in Barton. Jin had chosen that sword to start with.
Difus hurriedly spread his wings and launched his flight magic.
But in the place where he flew up, another of Runcandel's Final Techniques was already descending.
Runcandel's 3rd Final Technique: Meteor Shower.
There was nowhere to escape.
Hundreds of sword energies that had filled the sky in the blink of an eye were splitting the clouds and disorienting Difus' vision.
While the drastically increased battle speed was disconcerting, Difus was fully capable of dealing with it up to this point.
It was entirely possible to send the errant attacks towards Ricarton Castle.
However, Jin had preemptively nailed the fact that he wouldn't have the leeway to do so.
That implied that he had fully learned all of Difus' patterns and responses during the Exploration War.
Jin was confident he could press on relentlessly, without giving Difus a chance to react to his attacks, or even catch his breath.

The moment Difus blocked the five streaks of the Meteor Shower, and tried to reflect the attack back towards Ricarton, Jin had already twisted the trajectory of the Meteor Shower and leapt up to unleash a new sword technique.
King's Sword's 1st Final Technique: Meteor Breaker.
This time, sword energy burst from the ground in contrast to the Meteor Shower.

Unlike the real King's Sword that Ron used, the sword energy did not shine ash-gray. However, Jin had altered the sword he saw in the Sword Emperor's War into the style of Runcandel and mastered it. He had received help from To Shin Ban when he trained at Raplarosa.
When the Meteor Shower and the Meteor Breaker interlocked around Difus, one of Difus's wings was torn apart.
'Regeneration will take 2 seconds.'
No matter how fast, it will take 2 seconds. It was the speed that Jin had confirmed several times earlier when he tore Difus' wings with his god power.
However, Jin had prepared the next sword even quicker than that.
Runcandel's 5th Secret Technique: Light Speed Stab.

Although his body was convulsing with aura and his center of gravity kept twisting due to using multiple Final Techniques at once, Jin showed a superhuman strength to unleash the Light Speed Stab even a bit faster than 2 seconds.
The Light Speed Stab pierced through Difus' remaining wing and passed through.
'4 seconds until the aura backflow calms down.'
The backflow did occur. Jin closed the distance while calming the backflow as Difus, who had fallen, regained his posture and repelled the remaining sword energy of the Meteor Shower.
Dephus was no longer able to handle the aftermath of Jin's off-target swords due to his defense.
When 4 seconds had passed, the distance between Jin and Dephus was twenty steps.
The backlash that Jin had experienced had completely halted, and Dephus's wings were on the verge of regeneration.
'By now, he would have realized. No matter what he does, my sword is faster than his regeneration.'
As expected, instead of floundering to widen the gap, Dephus rather approached Jin and swung his Bolgarr.
The enormous blade drenched in chaos was falling towards Jin's head.
However, the move Jin foresaw with his switched sword was the end of this fight.
'He only thinks he lacks the time to deploy Eternity.'
That was the truth. Even Jin could not fully unfold Eternity in such a dire battle.
Therefore, he had to accumulate time to deploy Eternity by always being slightly ahead in the battle.
He had to corner Dephus step by step, until there was only a cliff left behind.
Runcandel's First Final Move, Sky-Splitting Strike.
Among the legacies left by Jordan, it was the top final move of the clan.
As soon as the Bradamante stuck in the ground, Dephus, who had been rushing, belatedly recognized what kind of sword move this was.
"You're sharp, it must be thanks to Brother Dephus's memories."
But it was too late.
Already, the aura that had corroded under the ground exploded, creating a massive sword aura that split the earth and sky.
Dephus hastily stepped aside, but the sword aura of the Sky-Splitting Strike also rose from that side.
The fragments of aura left in the sky by the Meteor Rain and Meteor Shattering were about to be swept up and pulverized by the Sky-Splitting Strike.
[Kraaaak...!]
The pulverized fragments of Meteor Rain pierced Dephus's back, and the sword aura of Sky-Splitting Strike was getting more ferocious, drilling through the ground and rushing to the sky.
One of them swallowed Dephus's freshly regenerated left wing and left arm whole.
If it had been the right arm holding the Bolgarr, the battle would have ended there.
But while the battle continued, the victory had already been decided.
Jin was confident in that. After all, Dephus had entered the battle prepared to lose from the beginning.
Dephus, knowing he would lose, drew Jin into a one-on-one duel to get him off the battlefield.
To buy time for Rosa to move.
Also, to drive Jin to despair.
Jin gritted his teeth once thinking about that intention.

"So, if I end up killing you like this... do you think I will despair? Don't delude yourself, Fourth Apostle of the Evil God. Sister Meri and I have already finished preparing to send off Brother Dephus."
Soon after, Jin, with his eyes wide open, swung his sword at Dephus again, concluding the Sky-Splitting Strike.
